xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DeclarationOfUnmodifiedOpinion: Statement on impact of audit qualification
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of Aastha Spintex Limited (formerly known as Aastha Spintex Private Limited) ("the Company" / "the Holding Company") for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 ("the Statement") have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 07, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out a limited review of the Statement and have issued a modified (qualified) conclusion thereon (refer note 2).

2. Cash on hand as at September 30, 2026 is Rs. 3952.82 lakhs (7.82% of total assets). It mainly relates to procurement, which in the Company's business are customarily settled in cash. Physical verification of cash on hand was not carried out as at the period end. The Statutory Auditors have therefore expressed a qualified conclusion in their limited review report. Management will carry out a physical verification of cash at the end of every quarter and has strengthened its controls over cash handling.

3. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles of Indian Accounting Standard 34 "Interim Financial Reporting" (Ind AS 34) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India, and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.

4. The equity shares of the Company were listed on NSE Limited and BSE Limited on July 06, 2026. The figures for the corresponding quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 and the statement of cash flows for the half year ended September 30, 2025 included in the Statement have not been subjected to limited review or audit by the Statutory Auditors. However, the Management has exercised necessary due diligence to ensure that these figures provide a true and fair view of the Company's affairs.

5. During the quarter, the Company completed its Initial Public Offering ("IPO") of 1,25,00,000 equity shares of face value Rs 10 each at an issue price of Rs 136 per share (including a premium of Rs 126 per share), aggregating to Rs 17,000.00 lakh, consisting entirely of a fresh issue. The equity shares were allotted on July 02, 2026 and listed on NSE Limited and BSE Limited on July 06, 2026. Consequently, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company increased from Rs 3,164.22 lakh to Rs 4,414.22 lakh comprising 4,41,42,190 equity shares of Rs 10 each.

6. Pursuant to the approval of the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on September 16, 2026, the Company allotted 4,41,42,190 fully paid-up bonus equity shares of Rs 10 each on September 29, 2026 in the ratio of 1:1 (one bonus equity share for every one equity share held) to the shareholders by capitalising Rs 4,414.22 lakh out of securities premium. Consequently, the paid-up equity share capital increased to Rs 8,828.44 lakh comprising 8,82,84,380 equity shares of Rs 10 each. In accordance with Ind AS 33 "Earnings per Share", basic and diluted earnings per share for all periods presented have been adjusted for the bonus issue.

7. Pursuant to one of the objects of the IPO, the Company acquired 100% of the equity share capital of Falcon Yarns Private Limited ("Falcon") for a total consideration of Rs 13,151.00 lakh. Falcon became a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with effect from August 19, 2026. In the consolidated financial results, the acquisition has been accounted for using the acquisition method under Ind AS 103 "Business Combinations". The financial results of Falcon have been consolidated on a line-by-line basis from the acquisition date, after eliminating intra-group balances and transactions.

8. In accordance with Ind AS 108 - Operating Segments, the Company and the Group operate in a single business segment i.e. "manufacturing of 100% Cotton Yarns and Cotton Bales".

9. Consequent to the acquisition stated in Note 7, the Company has prepared consolidated financial results for the first time for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The consolidated financial results include the results of the Holding Company and its wholly owned subsidiary, Falcon Yarns Private Limited, from August 19, 2026. As the Company had no subsidiary, associate or joint venture before that date, comparative figures for previous periods have not been presented in the consolidated financial results.

10. The utilisation of the gross proceeds of the IPO up to September 30, 2026 is as under (Rs in lakh):
(a) Acquisition of 100% equity shares of Falcon Yarns Private Limited - Amount as proposed in Offer Document: 11,151.00; Utilised up to 30.09.2026: 11,151.00; Unutilised as at 30.09.2026: Nil
(b) Funding working capital requirements of Falcon Yarns Private Limited - Amount as proposed in Offer Document: 1,000.00; Utilised up to 30.09.2026: 1,000.00; Unutilised as at 30.09.2026: Nil
(c) General corporate purposes - Amount as proposed in Offer Document: 4,047.00; Utilised up to 30.09.2026: 4,043.52; Unutilised as at 30.09.2026: 3.48
(d) Issue related expenses - Amount as proposed in Offer Document: 802.00; Utilised up to 30.09.2026: 700.98; Unutilised as at 30.09.2026: 101.02
Total - Amount as proposed in Offer Document: 17,000.00; Utilised up to 30.09.2026: 16,895.50; Unutilised as at 30.09.2026: 104.50
There is no deviation from the stated objects, and the monitoring agency report was reviewed.

11. All the amounts included in the financial results are rounded off to the nearest lakh, except per share data and unless stated otherwise.

12. The figures for the corresponding previous year have been regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary, to make them comparable.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAuditQualificationExp: As stated in Note 2 to the Statement, the Holding Company has reported cash on hand of Rs 3,952.82 lakh as at September 30, 2026. The Management of the Holding Company has not carried out a physical verification of cash on hand as at the period end, and the explanations furnished to us regarding the nature of the balance have not been corroborated by a physical verification as at that date. In the absence of such verification, we were unable to obtain sufficient information through our review procedures about the existence of the said cash balance as at September 30, 2026. Consequently, we are unable to determine whether any adjustments are required to the cash balance and the consequential effects, if any, on the profit, total comprehensive income and other equity reported in the Statement.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ManagementsEstimationOnTheImpa: Management is unable to estimate the impact at present (refer (ii) below). The cash on hand as per the books of account of the Holding Company is held mainly for the procurement of cotton, which in its business is customarily settled in cash. Out of the cash on hand of Rs 3,952.82 lakh as at September 30, 2026, Rs 2,161.05 lakh has been deposited in the Holding Company’s cash credit accounts with Bank of Baroda in 21 deposits between October 1, 2026 and November 6, 2026. Management believes that the balance is fully available and does not expect any adjustment.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonsIfManagementIsUnableToE: Physical verification of cash on hand was not carried out as at September 30, 2026. Management has initiated a physical count of the entire cash on hand, in the presence of the Statutory Auditors, with a reconciliation back to September 30, 2026 through the cash book. The impact, if any, can be determined only when this exercise is completed. Management will carry out a physical verification of cash at the end of every quarter and has strengthened its controls over cash handling.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AuditorsCommentsOnManagementsE: In the absence of a physical verification of cash on hand as at September 30, 2026, we were unable to obtain sufficient information about the existence of the cash balance of Rs 3,952.82 lakh and are therefore unable to comment on the adjustments, if any, that may be required. We will examine the results of the physical count and the reconciliation to September 30, 2026 when they are made available to us.
